description: This file defines the 'GatewayConnection' actor and related types for managing WebSocket connections to a gateway server, including request handling, subscription management, and various API methods for communication, health checks, skill management, sessions, chat, voice wake triggers, node and device pairing, and cron job management.

classes.name: GatewayConnection
classes.description: An actor managing the WebSocket connection to the gateway, providing methods for sending requests, subscribing to push updates, and performing gateway API calls.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Low-level method to send a request via WebSocket, with internal auto-recovery logic.

methods.name: requestRaw
methods.description: Internal method to send raw request data with different overloads.

methods.name: requestDecoded
methods.description: Performs a request and decodes the response into a specified Decodable type.

methods.name: requestVoid
methods.description: Performs a request expecting no return value.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconfigures the WebSocket connection based on current configuration.

methods.name: authSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication source from the current client, if any.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the current WebSocket connection and clears state.

methods.name: canvasHostUrl
methods.description: Returns the host URL of the Canvas, if available.

methods.name: cachedMainSessionKey
methods.description: Returns the cached main session key from the latest snapshot if available.

methods.name: cachedGatewayVersion
methods.description: Returns the cached version string of the Gateway server.

methods.name: snapshotPaths
methods.description: Returns paths to configuration and state directories from the latest snapshot.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates an async stream of GatewayPush updates for subscribers.

methods.name: mainSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the main session key from the gateway, optionally using cache.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks the availability (health) of the gateway.

methods.name: setHeartbeatsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables heartbeat messages.

methods.name: sendAgent
methods.description: Sends a message via the agent interface.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event with specified parameters.

methods.name: healthSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a health snapshot from the gateway.

methods.name: healthOK
methods.description: Checks if the health snapshot indicates the gateway is OK.

methods.name: skillsStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of skills from the gateway.

methods.name: skillsInstall
methods.description: Installs a skill by name with specified installation ID.

methods.name: skillsUpdate
methods.description: Updates a skill with specified parameters.

methods.name: sessionsPreview
methods.description: Gets previews of sessions by session keys.

methods.name: chatHistory
methods.description: Retrieves chat history for a session.

methods.name: chatSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message, possibly with attachments.

methods.name: chatAbort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run.

methods.name: talkMode
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode.

methods.name: voiceWakeGetTriggers
methods.description: Retrieves triggers for voice wake.

methods.name: voiceWakeSetTriggers
methods.description: Sets triggers for voice wake.

methods.name: nodePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a node pairing request.

methods.name: nodePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a node pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairApprove
methods.description: Approves a device pairing request.

methods.name: devicePairReject
methods.description: Rejects a device pairing request.

methods.name: cronStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the cron scheduler.

methods.name: cronList
methods.description: Lists cron jobs, optionally including disabled.

methods.name: cronRuns
methods.description: Retrieves logs of cron job runs.

methods.name: cronRun
methods.description: Triggers a cron job execution.

methods.name: cronRemove
methods.description: Removes a cron job.

methods.name: cronUpdate
methods.description: Updates a cron job with a patch.

methods.name: cronAdd
methods.description: Adds a new cron job.
